description: The bottom dock is centered in a horizontal surface spanning the 1024px output width, with four icons ordered left to right.

assertions.comment: The bottom dock client surface requests the 1024px output width and calculated height of 108px
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) is centered at x=402, which is (1024-220)/2
The bottom panel is at y=36 on the 108px surface, accounting for the 64px panel and 8px Floating margin
The calculated bottom-edge position for the unnamed panel path is 36px
Bottom dock icons have increasing x coordinates from left to right
The horizontal dock’s default DockItem width is 48px, equal to IconSize
The horizontal dock’s DockItem height is 56px: a 48px icon plus 8px for the launch indicator
